name: Bilobalide
aliases: Baiguo, Adiantifolia, Bai Guo Ye, Fossil Tree, Ginkgo Folium, Herba Ginkgo Biloba, Japanese Silver Apricot, Kew Tree
summary: Bilobalide is a biologically active terpenic trilactone present in Ginkgo biloba.

pharmacology.text: Bilobalide is important for producing several of the effects of Ginkgo biloba extracts, and it has neuroprotective effects, as well as inducing the liver enzymes CYP3A1 and CYP1A2, which may be partially responsible for interactions between ginkgo and other herbal medicines or pharmaceutical drugs. Bilobalide has recently been found to be a negative allosteric modulator at the GABAA and GABAA-rho receptors.

summaryZh: 白果內酯（英語：Bilobalide）是一種存在於銀杏中的具有生物活性的萜烯三內酯。

uses.en: It is not used on its own as a medicine. Ginkgo extracts containing it are sold as supplements for memory and circulation, and bilobalide is studied for its protective effects on nerve cells.
uses.zh: 它本身不作為藥物使用。含有它的銀杏萃取物作為改善記憶與循環的保健食品販售，而白果內酯本身則因對神經細胞的保護作用而被研究。
uses.zhHans: 它本身不作为药物使用。含有它的银杏萃取物作为改善记忆与循环的保健食品贩售，而白果内酯本身则因对神经细胞的保护作用而被研究。

sideEffects.en: Ginkgo extracts can cause headache, stomach upset and dizziness, and they can make bleeding more likely. Bilobalide blocks GABA-A receptors in the laboratory, and compounds that do this can lower the seizure threshold.
sideEffects.zh: 銀杏萃取物可能造成頭痛、腸胃不適與頭暈，並可能提高出血的機會。白果內酯在實驗室中會阻斷 GABA-A 受體，而具此作用的化合物可能降低癲癇發作的閾值。
sideEffects.zhHans: 银杏萃取物可能造成头痛、肠胃不适与头晕，并可能提高出血的机会。白果内酯在实验室中会阻断 GABA-A 受体，而具此作用的化合物可能降低癫痫发作的阈值。

fact.en: It comes from the ginkgo tree, the last survivor of a plant family that goes back over two hundred million years. Ginkgos also survived the Hiroshima bombing and resprouted the next spring.
fact.zh: 白果內酯來自銀杏樹，這是一個可追溯至兩億多年前的植物家族的最後倖存者。廣島原子彈爆炸後，銀杏仍然存活並在隔年春天重新萌芽。
fact.zhHans: 白果内酯来自银杏树，这是一个可追溯至两亿多年前的植物家族的最后幸存者。广岛原子弹爆炸后，银杏仍然存活并在隔年春天重新萌芽。
